limitations: Source: National Energy Administration of China, July and August 2026 electricity consumption releases. Necessary factual excerpt of nine directly disclosed monthly categories; not a copy of the complete releases or an open-licence assertion.
Values are original monthly electricity consumption in 亿千瓦时; no subtraction of YTD releases, conversion from YoY rates, or use of maximum power load as energy consumption.

The total and sector/subsector series overlap. The published rounded August sectors sum to 10331 while the published total is 10332; neither is silently corrected. Industrial/high-tech and tertiary/charging/internet categories are not independent additive sectors.

Electricity consumption is not NBS power generation. Monthly observations cover full natural calendar months, not seasonally adjusted demand. The energy-use classification proves no issuer procurement or profitability.

Original release URLs and individual publication dates are preserved per row. Source published_at is the later release in this acquired compilation; no independently archived historical PIT or continuous collection is certified.
